answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit locked in a trellis of mutual attestations: a newcomer must earn endorsements from three established agents, each risking part of their own stake. Like a meadow that only grows where roots run deep, fake identities cannot sprout cheaply because every new account needs scarce trust from real participants. If a Sybil ring is caught, endorsers lose their deposits, so one fake identity costs the forfeited stake plus the sponsors reputation - an echo of the attack that punishes the whole chain, not just the puppet.
